0.why: Disee.cpp:64 takes getChannels() on this input and Disee.cpp:74 reads channel c with getPolyVoltage

comment: Disee.cpp:76 calls setVoltage with no channel index inside the per-channel loop, so all sixteen filtered values are written to channel 0 in turn while Disee.cpp:65 has already set the output's channel count from the input. The polyphonic output is therefore wrong; the first line of the entry and the second Note say so. The one-pole filter corner is 1Hz, set at Disee.cpp:69, which is where "roughly a second" comes from.
